1.

Prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to Respondent No. 2, Special Land Acquisition Officer, (Sanyukt Sangthan) Varanasi to decide the application of the petitioner dated 24.04.2023 filed under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 within specified time frame.
2. The application aforesaid has been filed by the petitioner on the basis of award dated 08.02.2023 seeking enhancement of the compensation.

sentences.text: 3. Having regard to the innocuous nature of prayer, we dispose of the instant petition with a direction to respondent no. 2 to decide the application expeditiously preferably within a period of twelve weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.
4. It is clarified that we have not expressed any opinion on the maintainability of the application and the said aspect would be examined by the concerned respondent while deciding the application.
